evidence: Over 1097 held-out weeks, the rule triggered 143 times. The modeled net maximum drawdown was -17.02% after cutting credit and -19.21% under the matched-rate hedge.
next_decision: Use the matched-rate comparison and stress-period outcomes to distinguish spread/liquidity exposure from rate sensitivity. The turnover threshold identifies when modeled trading costs reverse the gross comparison.
boundary: A backtest using fund NAVs is a modeled portfolio. Shorting and funding spreads beyond the stated transaction cost can change the comparison. The non-rate residual includes liquidity and issuer-specific risk.
